cadence.micro: After each result, comment, branch, agent handoff, or failure.
cadence.meso: After each repo or dependency batch, collapse duplicate work and publish one operator brief.
cadence.macro: At each golden-priority burn, measure unresolved owner decisions, open tabs, and rework.
cadence.meta: After each dogfood session, update the heuristics and failure corpus from repeated prompts or anger escalation.

default_next_action: Collapse duplicate work, name the highest-reach unresolved gate, and issue one owner-ready next action.
